description: Class representing a container for the document content.

AddCaption.description:
Adds a caption paragraph after (or before) the current content control.
<note>Please note that the current content control must be in the document (not in the footer/header).
And if the current content control is placed in a shape, then a caption is added after (or before) the parent shape.</note>

params.description: The additional text.
params.name: additionalText

params.description: The caption label.
params.name: label

params.description: Specifies whether to exclude the label from the caption.
params.name: excludeLabel

params.description: The possible caption numbering format.
params.name: numFormat

params.description: Specifies whether to insert the caption before the current content control (true) or after (false) (after/before the shape if it is placed in the shape).
params.name: isBefore

params.description: The heading level (used if you want to specify the chapter number).<note>If you want to specify "Heading 1", then nHeadingLvl === 0 and etc.</note>
params.name: headingLvl

params.description: The caption separator (used if you want to specify the chapter number).
params.name: captionSep

AddCaption.signature: AddCaption(additionalText: string, label?: CaptionLabel | string, excludeLabel?: boolean, numFormat?: CaptionNumberingFormat, isBefore?: boolean, headingLvl?: number, captionSep?: CaptionSep): boolean

AddComment.description:
Adds a comment to the current block content control.
<note>Please note that the current block content control must be in the document.</note>

params.description: The comment text.
params.name: text

params.description: The author's name.
params.name: author

params.description: The user ID of the comment author.
params.name: userId

returns.description: Returns null if the comment was not added.

AddComment.signature: AddComment(text: string, author?: string, userId?: string): ApiComment

AddElement.description: Adds a paragraph or a table or a block content control to the current container.

params.description: The type of the element which will be added to the current container.
params.name: element

params.description: The specified position.
params.name: pos

AddText.description: Adds a text to the current content control.

params.description: The text which will be added to the content control.
params.name: text

returns.description: returns false if param is invalid.

Copy.description: Creates a copy of a block content control. Ignores comments, footnote references, complex fields.

Delete.description: Removes a content control and its content. If keepContent is true, the content is not deleted.

params.description: Specifies if the content will be deleted or not.
params.name: keepContent

returns.description: returns false if content control haven't parent.

GetAlias.description: Returns the alias attribute for the current container.

GetAllContentControls.description: Returns a collection of content control objects in the current content control.

GetAllDrawingObjects.description: Returns a collection of drawing objects in the current content control.

GetAllParagraphs.description: Returns a collection of paragraph objects in the current content control.

GetAllTablesOnPage.description:
Returns a collection of tables on a given absolute page.
<note>This method can be a little bit slow, because it runs the document calculation
process to arrange tables on the specified page.</note>

params.description: Page number. If it is not specified, an empty array will be returned.
params.name: page

GetAppearance.description: Gets the visualization of the content control.

GetBackgroundColor.description: Returns the background color of the current content control.

GetBorderColor.description: Returns the border color of the current content control.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiBlockLvlSdt class.

GetContent.description: Returns the content of the current container.

GetDataBinding.description: Retrieves the data binding of the content control.

returns.description: Returns the data binding of the content control if it exists, otherwise `null`.

GetDataForXmlMapping.description: Returns the content control data for the XML mapping.

returns.description: The string data representing the contents of the current content control.

GetDropdownList.description: Returns a list of values of the combo box / drop-down list content control.

GetId.description: Returns a unique ID for the current content control.

GetInternalId.description: Returns an internal id of the current content control.

GetLabel.description: Returns the label attribute for the current container.

GetLock.description: Returns the lock type of the current container.

GetParent.description: Returns the document content that contains the current content control.

returns.description: returns the main document, a document part (table cell, header/footer, footnote, etc.), or null if the content control has no parent.

GetParentContentControl.description: Returns a content control that contains the current content control.

returns.description: returns null if parent content control doesn't exist.

GetParentTable.description: Returns a table that contains the current content control.

returns.description: returns null is parent table does'n exist.

GetParentTableCell.description: Returns a table cell that contains the current content control.

returns.description: returns null if parent cell doesn't exist.

GetPlaceholderText.description: Returns the placeholder text from the current content control.

GetPosInParent.description: Returns the content control position within its parent element.

returns.description: returns -1 if the content control parent doesn't exist.

GetRange.description: Returns a Range object that represents the part of the document contained in the specified content control.

params.description: Start position index in the current element.
params.name: start

params.description: End position index in the current element.
params.name: end

GetTag.description: Returns the tag attribute for the current container.

IsPicture.description:
Checks whether the content control is a picture control.
This method verifies if the content control is specifically a picture control.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the content control is a picture, otherwise `false`.

MoveCursorOutside.description: Places a cursor before/after the current content control.

params.description: Specifies whether a cursor will be placed before (false) or after (true) the current content control.
params.name: isAfter

Push.description: Pushes a paragraph or a table or a block content control to actually add it to the current container.

params.description: The type of the element which will be pushed to the current container.
params.name: element

RemoveAllElements.description: Clears the contents from the current content control.

ReplaceByElement.description: Replaces the current content control with a new element.

params.description: The element to replace the current content control with.
params.name: oElement

Search.description: Searches for a scope of a content control object. The search results are a collection of ApiRange objects.

params.description: Search string, or a regular expression to match. When a RegExp is passed, the isMatchCase parameter is ignored (control case sensitivity with the "i" flag instead).
params.name: text

params.description: Case sensitive or not.
params.name: isMatchCase

Search.signature: Search(text: string | RegExp, isMatchCase?: boolean): ApiRange[]

SetAlias.description: Sets the alias attribute to the current container.

params.description: The alias which will be added to the current container.
params.name: alias

SetAppearance.description: Sets the visualization of the content control.

params.description: The desired type of visualization.
params.name: type

SetBackgroundColor.description: Sets the background color to the current content control.

params.description: The background color.
params.name: color

SetBorderColor.description: Sets the border color to the current content control.

params.description: The border color.
params.name: color

SetDataBinding.description: Sets the data binding for the content control.

params.description: The data binding to associate with the content control.
params.name: xmlMapping

SetId.description: Specifies a unique ID for the current content control.

params.description: The numerical ID which will be specified for the current content control.
params.name: id

SetLabel.description: Sets the label attribute to the current container.

params.description: The label which will be added to the current container. Can be a positive or negative integer from **-2147483647** to **2147483647**.
params.name: label

SetLock.description:
Sets the lock to the current block text content control:
**"unlocked"** - content can be edited and the container can be deleted.
**"contentLocked"** - content cannot be edited.
**"sdtContentLocked"** - content cannot be edited and the container cannot be deleted.
**"sdtLocked"** - the container cannot be deleted.

params.description: The type of the lock applied to the block text content control.
params.name: lockType

SetPicture.description:
Sets the content (image) for the picture content control.
This method updates the picture inside a content control by setting an image from a provided URL.
The URL should be an internet link to the image.

params.description: The URL of the image to be used for the content control.Currently, only internet URLs are supported.
params.name: imageUrl

returns.description: Returns `true` if the image was successfully set, otherwise `false`.

SetPlaceholderText.description: Sets the placeholder text to the current content control.

params.description: The text that will be set to the current content control.
params.name: text

SetTag.description: Sets the tag attribute to the current container.

params.description: The tag which will be added to the current container.
params.name: tag

SetTextPr.description: Applies text settings to the content of the content control.

params.description: The properties that will be set to the content of the content control.
params.name: textPr

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiBlockLvlSdt object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the used numberings will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteNumberings

params.description: Specifies if the used styles will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteStyles

UpdateFromXmlMapping.description: Updates the content control using the value from the XML mapping.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the update was successful, otherwise `false`.
